s.note: Warm salty boiled peanuts with Old Bay and lemon, carnival night snacking.
s.how: Rinse the peanuts and put them in a big pot with 3 litres of water, the salt, Old Bay and bay leaves. Weigh them down with a plate, bring to the boil and simmer until the shells are soft and the nuts are tender. Leave them in the brine for 10 minutes, then drain and serve warm with lemon.

s.note: Blue swimmer crab cakes and Creole remoulade. 365 letters.
s.how: Mix the crab, egg, 3 tbsp mayo, mustard, half the panko, spring onions and half the lemon juice, then shape into 8 small cakes. Press the cakes into the rest of the panko and chill for 10 minutes. Stir the 125g mayo with the capers, paprika and remaining lemon for the remoulade. Fry the cakes in the oil until golden on both sides and serve with the remoulade.
shop: 3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise, plus 125g for the remoulade@Pantry

m.n: Bird for bird buttermilk fried chicken
m.note: Buttermilk chicken, honey and crunchy slaw.
m.how: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt, at least 2 hours or overnight. Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt, and dredge the chicken until shaggy. Fry in oil at 170C, turning, until deep gold and cooked through. Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and vinegar. Drizzle the chicken with honey and serve with the slaw.
shop: 8 chicken thighs, bone in, skin on@Meat

m.note: Garlic prawns, smoky bacon and buttery grits.
m.how: Bring the milk and 500ml water to a simmer and whisk in the grits; cook, stirring, until thick and soft, then beat in half the butter and the cheddar. Fry the bacon until crisp, then add the garlic and the rest of the butter. Add the prawns and cayenne and cook just until pink, then squeeze over the lemon. Spoon the prawns over the grits and scatter with spring onion.

w.note: Warm peaches, buttermilk biscuit top and cream.
w.how: Toss the peaches with the brown sugar, cornflour and cinnamon and tip into a baking dish. Rub the butter into the flour and caster sugar, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls over the peaches and bake at 190C until golden and bubbling. Serve warm with cold cream.
shop: 6 ripe peaches, sliced (or 2 x 825g tins, drained)@Produce

d.n: Middle of the street bourbon sweet tea
d.note: Black tea, peach, lemon and bourbon on ice.
d.how: Steep the tea bags in 800ml just-boiled water, then stir in the sugar and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, peach and lemon. Pour in the bourbon and top with the sweet tea.
